div.div: كَبَرٌ [The caper, or capparis of Linnæus;] a certain plant having thorns; (TA;) an arabicized word, from the Persian [كَبَرْ]; (S;) called in Arabic لَصَفٌ, (Mgh,) or أَصَفٌ: (S, K:) the vulgar say ↓ كُبَّارٌ . (K.) A beverage is described as made of كَبَر and barley: كثر is a mistranscription. (Mgh.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
